en.title: Archie Owen Claims first F4 victory as Aramco F4 Saudi Arabian Championship opens at Jeddah Corniche Circuit
en.summary: Welsh driver Archie Owen won the opening race of the 2026 Aramco F4 Saudi Arabian Championship at Jeddah Corniche Circuit, starting fourth and overtaking to secure first place ahead of Harrison Mackie and Marlon Bayer.
